setup: One browser session, normal browser/CDN caches, season 2026/2027, focus=all. Browser Resource Timing captured the initial homepage after its data loaded, then cumulative client navigation and one additional full-document alias navigation. Cache clearing was unsupported; no cache disabling was applied.
expected: All nine main routes load. Measure received browser bytes separately from any estimate of Neon outbound billing. No individual profiles or additional historical seasons are opened.
command: Run the CUA/CDP reproduction cells in bandwidth-method-20261103.md. No build or production configuration change is required.

observedCdnResponses.note: CDP network recording began after initial homepage requests; this subset is not a complete per-visit Neon billing meter.

limitations: Normal browser caches were retained; this is an observed session, not a forced globally cold CDN experiment.
Eight pages used client navigation; /calendrier performed a full document navigation and repeated season downloads.
Per-route cumulative snapshots can include background activity from the preceding route; whole-session totals are the useful comparison.
The default visible pages were measured, not every match/player/club detail or every historical season.
Neon outbound billing cannot be isolated from browser bytes or project counters while ingestion and other clients are active.
Unique football decoded body bytes describe response payload size, not an exact Neon outbound billing amount. SQL/S3 reads and server caches can differ.
